Business-type from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7) Total column; receipts/disbursements totals = operating + nonoperating interest (no single printed total). ending_cash = cash + county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (restricted cash 2,072,075 excluded). Detail: the budgetary comparison schedule (p9) is a combined all-funds function-level schedule, so detail uses the per-fund columns of the governmental funds statement (General, Street, Debt Service, Sales Tax, Park), the combining schedule of other governmental funds (p10: Law Enforcement, Keno, Reading Center) and the per-fund proprietary columns (p7); interest income/expense are nonoperating lines outside the printed operating totals. General Fund capital outlay 30,751 has no function printed (labelled Capital Outlay). The proprietary fund net position statement (p6) splits net position NIC 2,829,392 / unrestricted (121,483) while the Statement of Net Position (p1) prints 2,224,392 / 483,517 for business-type (same total 4,596,847); p1 used.
